errors.summary: MCP unit test expected MCP-Protocol-Version header on initialize, but current client sends protocolVersion in the initialize body and headers on later session calls.
Playwright wrapper launch used an inline environment variable that expanded to an empty command path.
Playwright UI inspection showed invalid MCP header JSON exposes a raw JSON.parse error message in the settings panel.
Playwright console reported that the OpenRouter password field is not contained in a form.
Settings draft reset used synchronous setState inside useEffect, which failed react-hooks/set-state-in-effect during npm run lint.
